scope: Resolve API-census and application-level return-order ambiguity before any source implementation. A prospective API list is not runtime or live-adapter authority.

pending_platform_stages.stream_identity_read_close: Six named APIs in the base contract remain source references; typed live implementation/review/qualification is absent.
pending_platform_stages.ancestor_and_run_root_metadata: Separate pending platform stage, described below. It cannot be supplied by the six stream APIs or by an unreviewed Path/os wrapper.
pending_platform_stages.output_namespace_write_flush_publish: Separate pending platform stage. CreateDirectoryW/CreateFileW/WriteFile/FlushFileBuffers/CloseHandle or equivalent exact reviewed operations and publication semantics still need a finite binding/call/ownership census before any real sink implementation. No hidden high-level filesystem fallback is authorized.

proposed_metadata_APIs.configuration: GetFileExInfoStandard with preallocated WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA; exact admitted ancestor or admitted scan-directory path only
proposed_metadata_APIs.ownership: No handle returned; reserve the call/record first, retain BOOL/error/raw output status before clock or conversion. Output buffer is undefined on failure and cannot prove safe ancestry.
proposed_metadata_APIs.acceptance: Require known directory and no FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT for required ancestors/directories; missing/failure/unknown remains incomplete or a source contradiction. This is an observation, not race-proof or permanent authentication.
proposed_metadata_APIs.call_cap_proposal: One call for each unique admitted ancestor U<=1024, plus at most8 directory checks per scan for at most2 scans: total<=1040. Exact U is computed before any metadata call; reject a roster that cannot fit.

proposed_metadata_APIs.signature: HANDLE(LPCWSTR, FINDEX_INFO_LEVELS, LPVOID, FINDEX_SEARCH_OPS, LPVOID, DWORD)
proposed_metadata_APIs.configuration: Only literal admitted_run_directory + wildcard star; FindExInfoBasic, FileExSearchNameMatch, NULL search filter and flags0. Constants/layout are pending SDK-source verification before implementation.
proposed_metadata_APIs.ownership: Preallocated search slot records the valid returned search handle before interpreting the first result or checking time. INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE transfers no handle; failed result data is undefined. Search slots have kind=file_search and closer=FindClose, never CloseHandle.
proposed_metadata_APIs.call_cap_proposal: At most8 explicitly admitted directories per scan and2 scans: <=16 calls. No search outside the exact terminated run root; no recursion into unknown/reparse directories.

proposed_metadata_APIs.configuration: Only an observed owned active search slot from this owner. Fixed preallocated result slots retain each returned row without overwriting late evidence.
proposed_metadata_APIs.ownership: Returns no new handle. Record success/known result or failure/error before post-call clock; a false return makes the output buffer undefined. Only observed ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES is natural end after an established search.
proposed_metadata_APIs.call_cap_proposal: Per scan: <=64 admitted non-dot entries, <=16 dot entries across8 directories, and1 overflow witness =><=81 successful record slots; allow at most8 terminal end calls =><=89 FindNext attempts per scan, <=178 overall. Stop at an overflow/error/unknown/deadline; no retry or cap increase.

proposed_metadata_APIs.configuration: Exactly the registered source-bound search-handle closer, one reservation/attempt per owned search slot
proposed_metadata_APIs.ownership: Retain returned success/failure/unknown before time/logging. Never retry an uncertain close and never route this handle through CloseHandle. Known/unknown close failure vetoes complete verification.
proposed_metadata_APIs.call_cap_proposal: At most one close per successful FindFirstFileExW: <=16. No new cleanup dispatch after original hard cutoff.

scan_policy.selection: The finite allowed directory/conditional artifact roster comes from the frozen source contract, never directory contents, reported image paths or child authority claims.
scan_policy.order: Retain OS return order and raw metadata; only after complete enumeration sort a separate canonical comparison index. OS ordering is not presumed stable or canonical.
scan_policy.dot_entries: Ignore literal dot and dot-dot for traversal only, after counting/bounding their observed records. Do not use alternate/8.3 names as locators.
scan_policy.empty_directory: An invalid initial handle with ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND is not an established iterator with natural end. A future implementation must have an explicit source-bound empty-directory rule and contemporaneous known-directory attributes, or conservatively mark it incomplete; this case is pending review and cannot be silently treated as complete.
scan_policy.reparse_and_unknown: Retain metadata, reject reparse/unknown name/type/directory/unterminated name/alias/over-cap observation before opening or traversing that entry. Successful enumeration is not physical file identity; the existing handle-based checks and fresh hash remain required.
scan_policy.stability: The second scan compares the same bounded run-root universe before work completion. Two matching scans are not an atomic snapshot or proof against hostile concurrent namespace mutation.
scan_policy.event_budget: Use bounded stage/search reservation and return events, not per-entry journal events. Exact actual directory count and bootstrap stages must fit the existing64 fixed events, or admission holds before any metadata dispatch; do not assume 6*N+64+128 still fits without that check.

proposed_sink_API_census_pending_impleme.CreateDirectoryW: BOOL(LPCWSTR, LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES); exactly one fixed new verifier directory under an already approved existing parent. Known TRUE grants namespace ownership before clock/allocation; existing/failed/unknown creates no write authority. No recursive parent creation.
proposed_sink_API_census_pending_impleme.CreateFileW: Existing typed function, distinct output use: GENERIC_WRITE, share0, CREATE_NEW, noninheritable, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, exact fixed owner basename only. Register valid raw output handle in a preallocated slot before write/flush/clock work; never replace an existing file.
proposed_sink_API_census_pending_impleme.WriteFile: BOOL(HANDLE,LPCVOID,DWORD,LPDWORD,LPOVERLAPPED), synchronous only. Reserve the attempt, retain known successful short-write count before clock/slicing/digest work. Continue successful partial writes under the same finite cap; never retry a failed/unreturned write or reset an offset to conceal its tail.
proposed_sink_API_census_pending_impleme.FlushFileBuffers: BOOL(HANDLE); one known acknowledgment per bounded record plus at most one final flush per file. A failed/late/unknown flush prevents completion.
proposed_sink_API_census_pending_impleme.CloseHandle: Existing typed stream closer, exactly once per owned output slot; retain returned success/failure/unknown before post-call clock. Search slots remain FindClose-only.
proposed_sink_API_census_pending_impleme.publication: No rename/delete API is proposed: CREATE_NEW artifacts can remain partial on failure, and missing/malformed/failed seal or any veto prevents eligibility. No in-place repair, replacement or hidden filesystem wrapper.

prospective_bounds.per_file_WriteFile_cap: record_cap + ceil(byte_cap/65536) +16 short-write headroom; record_cap=2048 for journal and1 otherwise
prospective_bounds.rule: Preflight exact future roster/event/report worst-case byte reservations against these proposals before originals open. Exhaustion is incomplete, never silently shortened, retried or raised. These are proposed sink-only caps, not changes to native target counters.

proposed_sink_API_census_pending_impleme.deadline: No sink native operation starts after the original hard cutoff. The pure engine's failure callback may return an in-memory veto instead of a late file write. Known output closes and final acknowledgment remain necessary for completion.

finite_loader_clarification.own_modules: An exact own-module plus dependency map is frozen before invocation. Own/helper names always resolve to this invocation's leased, hash-bound captured bytes and freshly compiled module objects.
finite_loader_clarification.no_cache_fallback: Do not accept an own-helper object merely because its name already exists in sys.modules. No default importlib, runpy, path finder, package discovery, linecache, inspect or traceback source-path fallback supplies own source.
finite_loader_clarification.stdlib: The explicit approved standard-library whitelist and module-object binding rules freeze with the loader source. Its setup happens after the origin and is charged to it; it is a disclosed interpreter/platform trust context, not new whole-stdlib authentication.
finite_loader_clarification.relative_imports: Resolve only through the frozen own package/module map and approved exact dependency relationships. Missing, additional, foreign cached or unresolved-relative modules fail closed rather than reading a path.
finite_loader_clarification.proof_boundary: Fresh source hashes/live leases/current invocation identity are mandatory; neither a cached module nor serialized validated flag completes a source gate.

application_return_order_limit.normative: Immediately means earliest application-level assignments after ctypes returns/converts a result into Python-visible values. Preallocated slots remove avoidable application allocations before registration; they do not make the OS-to-Python transition atomic or allocation-free.
application_return_order_limit.handle_rule: After a Python-visible valid handle exists, assign it and its owned/observed state to the preexisting slot before int conversion, dictionary construction, identity calls, clocks, logging or other deliberate application allocations.
application_return_order_limit.read_rule: The corresponding known-count rule begins when success/count are Python-visible. A failure while conversion/return observation is incomplete preserves unknown state, not zero bytes or a no-side-effect claim.
application_return_order_limit.gap: A native operation may have acquired a resource even if Python never observes its return. Such an unknown outcome cannot be guessed closed or used as positive evidence; no universal cleanup guarantee is claimed.
application_return_order_limit.fake_scope: Injected tests can prove the deliberate application ordering after a returned observation and preservation of unknown gaps. They cannot prove atomic native/ctypes delivery or absence of mid-call process death.
